ONE TRANSACTION HISTORY
Policy changes/Premium adjustments/Carrier reporting

A POLICY CHANGE, EXPLAINED

A €10,000 adjustment.
Two carrier amounts.

An agreed €10,000 additional premium, less 15% commission, creates an €8,500 net adjustment. A 60/40 carrier split allocates €5,100 and €3,400, linked to the same change.

FOLLOW THE TRANSACTION

From endorsement
to an explained amount.

The insured value changes from €24.5m to €28.0m. Policy v1 remains available, the endorsement creates v2, and transaction TX-002 records the agreed additional premium. Follow the three steps to see the report.

CONNECTED INSURANCE OPERATIONS

Your business.
One connected workflow.

Keep policy history, premium movements and carrier reporting together, so your team can follow a change through to the amount owed.

  1. 01

    Structure the accepted business.

    Record the agreed policy, risk and premium details in one place, with the references your team needs to follow the business.

  2. 02

    Keep every change in context.

    Handle agreed policy changes and premium adjustments while preserving earlier versions and linked transactions.

  3. 03

    Connect premiums, commissions and shares.

    Keep gross premium, commission, net premium and carrier allocations together in the same record.

  4. 04

    Create traceable carrier reports.

    Generate CSV bordereaux from recorded transactions, preserving the report snapshot and its linked carrier obligations.

  5. 05

    Follow each amount back to its change.

    Trace report entries and carrier obligations to the policy version and premium adjustment behind them.

Built around your workflow: we agree your data setup, carrier reporting requirements and implementation scope with your team.
